scripts.postinstall: cd storefront-app && npm install && npm run build:css
scripts.dev: concurrently -n storefront,api -c blue,yellow "cd storefront-app && npm run dev" "cd api-worker && wrangler dev --config wrangler.toml --port 8787"
scripts.build: npm run build:storefront && npm run build:api
scripts.db:init: cd api-worker && wrangler d1 execute store-platform-db --local --file=../infra/db/schema.sql
scripts.db:seed: cd api-worker && wrangler d1 execute store-platform-db --local --file=../infra/db/seed.sql
